title: A build run returned clean while the implementer listed acceptance items as unfinished
notes: A task could merge with a viewer-facing criterion unverified. Until promoted the lead reads the unfinished list at each run's end. Promote on: a second such run, or any merged task later found with an unverified criterion; then a one-line build.js change made when no run is going. Promoted on its second occurrence (JS-161's rebuild, 2026-11-23) and fixed by #261: build.js returns unfinished items and such a run is not clean.
